diagnostics.message: these two handles are already related as "pairs-with" at array position 0, and this edge relates them as "substitutes-for". The house cannot coherently say both "have these together" and "have this INSTEAD" about one pair — the two render as different acts, and a customer asking about either end would be told both. Keep the relation the house actually means; the direction of the edges does not rescue it, which is why this is keyed on the unordered pair.
